title: Estrada asks court to reconsider dropping of Bonoan in plunder, graft cases
summary: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada urged the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division to revisit its move to allow for the dropping of graft and plunder cases against former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan.…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Jinggoy Estrada urged the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division to revisit its move to allow for the dropping of graft and plunder cases against former DPWH Secretary Manuel Bonoan. In a 20-page motion for reconsideration filed on Sept. 7 but only furnished to the media over the weekend, they said that the sudden discharge of Bonoan from the case “demonstrated a foul play or unfair practice” by prosecutors. “This belated change of heart on the part of accused Bonoan in order to save himself clearly demonstrates a ‘foul play or unfair practice’ on the part of prosecutors,” the senator’s […]...
